projects.observation: The four moons follow prescribed circular paths. The ship feels Jupiter and the moving moons. The game advances it with a step-size-controlled fourth-order Runge–Kutta method. See galileo.mjs for a separately integrated one-hour coast.
The three-site console distinguishes a reported body position, a reference position, and whether action may proceed. Its own display labels the system an architecture proposal.
The interface describes a weighted heuristic. No representative labeled corpus or independently measured false-positive rate was available in this scan.
